author: skullmonkey9999
quote:
A masterclass in how to do a remake: it respects the essence of the original, improves what needed improving, and never betrays anything that made it great. 
The defining gaming representation of the hero's journey; Link goes from being a boy of the forest without a fairy to the hero of time, carrying the fate of an entire kingdom with him, and you grow alongside with every temple and every decision. Dignifying and elevating moral values: courage, friendship, loyalty, and kindness aren't decoration, they're the heart of the adventure. 
Dungeons are very well designed, just as they were in the original, and the music is unforgettable, with the most iconic melodies in the gaming history. The ocarina isn't just a plot device but an emotional part of the experience, (as well as a playable instrument in-game). All in all, the game-feel is perfect, exactly as a perfect game should be.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: skullmonkey9999
quote:
Far from perfect, this installment delivers what the franchise does best: criminal chaos, a huge map, and a world that reacts to what you do. But it falls short of that premise. On the story side, I’d say there are plenty of memorable missions and good character appearances, but there are others that lean toward being a kind of life simulator, which is tedious and boring. They fall into a cliché of interactions that force you to do activities far from what the series used to do, and this drags down the protagonists, who in my view have the least personality of the whole saga, without a doubt. I think Claude is more iconic, and he doesn’t say a single **** have to be objective when judging a game that has been in development for eight years, but many of us expected a lot and feel let down by the characters and the way the story unfolds when compared to earlier entries. It’s fair to say the gameplay is by far the best open-world game to date, but the story and its characters are the weakest in the series, and a letdown for many veteran players who were used to that epic, movie-style criminal saga.
 I believe this game realistically deserves a score between 86 and 92. The score I’ve left here is a deliberate protest, meant to push back against inflated ratings and remind people that this game is far from perfect.
